thread:
Samir Patel: Quick sync — ACME NYC asked for a carveout on commitments: lower minimum, higher burst, and a grace period for first 3 months. Thinking this could be a pilot. Thoughts?

Elaine Cho: Can you paste the exact asks? hard to evaluate otherwise.

Samir Patel: Sure — from CS: 
- Commit 250k tokens/mo (instead of 1M) for first 6 months
- Burst allowance up to 2x committed for 30% surcharge
- 3-month waive of overage invoicing (still throttled above 3x)

Ben Ortiz: Low commit + burst is fine technically, main worry is precedence. If we do this for ACME, others will ask. Need clear launch criteria.

Olivia Wang: Agree on precedent. Proposal: make pilot explicit and timeboxed, with CLA that it’s a reference program. Also require them to run our cost/latency evals and share monthly usage traces.

Samir Patel: Draft launch criteria I sketched: 
- Pilot limited to 1 customer per region
- Minimum 3-month pilot, opt-in to extended 6-month if usage meets threshold
- Must pass infra perf eval (p95 latency <= target)
- Commit billing shape: discounted commit tier + documented burst surcharge
- Legal: carveout clause & non-transferability

Ben Ortiz: Also add rollback triggers: sustained >30% unit-cost delta vs expected for 2 consecutive months OR service incidents attributable to burst routing.

Elaine Cho: For product we need instrumentation hooks: per-route token tagging + a summary metric for effective unit cost. Also UI work: show their commit and burst consumption in Console. That’s +2 sprints.

Olivia Wang: Can we short-circuit UI by giving them CSV reports initially? would reduce scope.

Samir Patel: CSV reports + Console badge is acceptable for pilot. Full Console rollout only if we generalize the feature.

Ben Ortiz: Pricing details: suggested surcharge = 30% on per-token rate for burst consumed beyond commit, capped at 2x burst. How do we calculate blended rates for invoices?

Samir Patel: Invoice model idea: 
- Invoice line 1: committed tokens at committed rate (prorated)
- Invoice line 2: burst tokens at surcharge rate
- Invoice line 3: over-throttle events (if >3x) flagged but not billed during 3-month waiver

Olivia Wang: Ops question: how will routing treat bursts? Do we map to a higher-cost pool or keep using existing pools? This affects latency SLAs.

Ben Ortiz: Technical suggestion: route burst to dedicated "burst-pool" with pre-warmed instances to avoid cold-start latencies. Costs higher but predictable. Need autoscale knobs.

Samir Patel: Noted. For Dedicated vs Hosted: ACME is hosted for now. We should allow same contract shape for Dedicated customers but implementation differs.

Elaine Cho: Dependencies: billing changes, back-end token tagging, CSV report generator, small Console badge + docs + legal SLA clause. Estimate: 3 sprints for minimal pilot build (CSV + tagging + billing) if we pull in one eng-ml and one billing engineer.

Ben Ortiz: Add rollout playbook: 
1) Preflight: perf eval & billing dry-run
2) Pilot activation: enable token tagging, start CSV reporting
3) Monitoring: weekly cost/latency check-ins
4) Exit criteria: extend / graduate / rollback based on thresholds

Samir Patel: Can product ops own weekly check-ins for pilot? I'll volunteer to run the first 6 weeks.

launch-bot: Reminder — create RFC for pilot by EOD Friday, otherwise it won't be on next planning.

Olivia Wang: I'll draft the RFC language for launch criteria and monitoring. Ben, can you add rollback thresholds?

Ben Ortiz: Yup — will add thresholds and the proposed burst-pool infra notes.

Elaine Cho: I'll scope Console badge + docs minimal copy. Please add ACME contact and legal lead in the RFC.

Samir Patel: ACME contacts: Nora (AM), Victor (procurement). Legal: Priya. Adding to RFC. Thanks all.

Olivia Wang: One more ask — capture "no precedent without senior signoff" clause so sales can't promise this on ad-hoc calls.

Samir Patel: Noted. Will include a short clause in RFC: "Any customer-specific carveouts require director-level approval and must be run as a timeboxed pilot."

Ben Ortiz: Cool. Next step: Olivia + Ben + Samir to have a 30m RFC sync tomorrow to finish wording.

Samir Patel: Meeting scheduled 09:30 PT tomorrow. I'll upload a first RFC draft after the sync.

Elaine Cho: Thanks — and can we tag this pilot in the roadmap as "pilot: low-commit burst" under Q2?

launch-bot: Added roadmap tag: pilot-low-commit-burst-Q2."
